company.name: Rows
company.shortDescription: Rows is the world’s smartest AI spreadsheet. Import cloud data, extract table from PDFs, and build powerful analysis and reports. Easy!
company.description: Rows develops a web application designed to bring computing to business people. Their application provides a spreadsheet solution that connects to other online services and application programming interfaces and automates applications while managing data with the power of the cloud. Rows aims to bridge the gap between traditional spreadsheet software and modern data needs by providing businesses and individuals with a powerful, flexible platform.
